permissions.defaults: ManageCertifications42,ViewCertifications43,ManageCertificationSetup44 default to department administrators. Department-admin fallback is explicit in the controller. Own personnel records remain visible; group-admin status alone does not authorize viewing others.

operations.ViewCertifications: Dashboard, other member/record read, unit read, CSV.
operations.ManageCertifications: Admin Add, other member edit/renew/credits/status/Verify, unit record management. It does not permit self-verification.
operations.ManageCertificationSetup: Types/templates/department settings/role requirement writes. Setup alone redirects dashboard to Types and does not show member evaluations.
operations.Reports_View: Interactive Compliance report uses the separate Reports_View policy and personnel visibility matrix.

normal_review_route.visible_navigation: Dashboard member name opens Person; record name opens Record. A populated typed dashboard cell links directly to Record. Person Add record goes to the Profile add form; use Dashboard Add Certification for the explicit admin Member selector exercise.
normal_review_route.own_no_verify: Record view only renders Verify when CanManage, PendingVerification and not IsSelf. Service independently refuses holder self-verification. This is the expected boundary on existing Boden51001.

verify_submit_boundary.before_capture: Pending Casey record with Verify visible.
verify_submit_boundary.after_required_capture: Actual saved-message/readback on Record: Active,VerifiedbyBoden and timestamp. No success claim until those real screens exist.
verify_submit_boundary.post_route: normal form generated for Certifications/Verify?id={actual record ID}; no direct/API replay.

normal_review_route.edit_renew_credit: Own or Manage canEdit; Edit uses Profile/EditCertification?certId. Renew and Addcredit use Bootstrap modals. Status changes use Bootstrap statusModal. No status test on baseline records.

rules: Code is normalized and unique within department; blank code is generated from name.
Default validity is optional1–600months; NeverExpires clears it. New Add form does not auto-calculate expiry from it. Renew modal suggests existingexpiry(or today)+defaultmonths(or12).
Unit scope hides person-only verification/credits and service forcibly clears both. Unit statuses are Active,Expired,Suspended; no unit verification/education lifecycle.
Scope cannot change after person or unit records reference the type. Code cannot change after a role requirement references it.
Inactive types are hidden from new active-person selections; existing records are retained. Do not equate category labels or starter templates with external credential validity.

template_gallery.behavior: Bootstrap modal with filter and template checkboxes; Addselected POST copies selected templates into department-owned catalog types. Matching existing codes are disabled and service rejects duplicatecodes. Filter/Cancel are read-only; applying templates is a write.
template_gallery.exercise: Read-only gallery/filter only. Leave allboxesunchecked,Cancel. Do not apply statutory templates.
template_gallery.scope: Person and Unit templates; category,authority,validity andverification flags are configurable starter data, not a legal/clinical authority.

admin_add_record.selectable_subjects: Normal selectable personnel only; fresh department membership validation on POST. Types are active nondeleted Person-scoped only.
admin_add_record.default_status: Controller posts Active; service turns NEW typed Active into PendingVerification when type.RequiresVerification istrue, even when created by an administrator. No immediate sign-off implied.
admin_add_record.date_boundary: Expireson is nullable; NeverExpires type forcesnull. For an expiring type with no expiry recorded, evaluator treats no date as openended. Enter the explicit future exercise expiry instead of assuming a type default filledit.
admin_add_record.uploads: Optional normal chooser; accepted jpg/jpeg/png/gif/pdf/doc/docx/txt/xls/xlsx up to10MB. No upload in minimal exercise; no document-authenticity claim.

role_requirements.entry: Personnel → Roles → Required certifications (existing role row; read-only exercise).
semantics: Only active Person types may be added to role requirements.
BlankAnyOfGroup rows are independent AND requirements; same numericAnyOfGroup forms OR alternatives.
Only failing mandatory requirements make role evaluation unqualified/removable; advisory failures are warnings.
Grace override supersedes departmentdefault; failure anchor useslatestlapsedexpiry,thenmemberSinceifprovided,thenrequirementAddedOn. Removal is strictlyAFTER deadline.
Off skips membership checks;WarnOnly permitsroleaddswithwarnings;Enforce blocksunqualifiednewroleadds andworker may removeexistingrole memberships aftergrace.
Saving requirements replaces omitted rows; do not Save any baseline role in this exercise.

settings_and_worker.off_boundary: Off is role-enforcement mode, not a global expiry/notification off switch. Sweep expiration/lead-day events and enabledholder/digest paths occur before/after the rolemode branch.
settings_and_worker.scheduler: Source schedules hourly command34; worker checks SweepEnabled and eachdepartmentlocalhour(default6),claims once perlocalday, releasesclaim onfailure. Runtime execution/delivery not tested here.
settings_and_worker.notifications: Expiry andlead-day domain events/holderpreferences/digest path exist; provider delivery or actual receipt is not proven by checkedsettings. WarnOnly records failing mandatory evaluations for summary; individual impending-removal notices belong toEnforce.
settings_and_worker.enforce_submit: Selecting Enforce alone savesnothing. Normal Settings Save when transitioningtoEnforce invokes nativeJSconfirmation andserverConfirmEnforcevalidation; do not submit it for footage.

csv.scope: Current category/scope and person group/role intersection. CSV excludes certification numbers/issuers/attachments/protectedvalues; no download success until actual file inspected.

report.entry: Compliance report tab, or Reports → Compliance report → View report
report.kind: Printable HTML report with People and Units matrices; no app one-click PDF button in this view. Browser Print→SavePDF is a browser operation, not demonstrated here.
report.scheduled_pdf: Separate Profile/Reporting→AddNewScheduledReport can select CertificationCompliance report14. Source deliveryworker renders internalHTML and converts toPDF for email ifconfigured/allowed. Do not create schedules or claim delivery/provider availability from this source-only trace.
report.visibility: Interactive report applies Reports_View andpersonvisibilitymatrix; scheduled internaldepartment report differs. Never invoke internalreport endpoint as a workaround.
